ledger: Man in white shirt | shaving neck and chin | shaving forehead and neck | repetitive cutting between body parts

findings.description: The video repeats the segment of the man shaving his neck seen at 00:00-00:01, appearing again identically at 00:05-00:09. Additionally, the forehead shaving segment from 00:02-00:04 is repeated at 00:10-00:11, indicating a looping error or redundant editing.
